title: NC Has Polynomial Size
statement: Every language in $	extsf{NC}$ has polynomial circuit size: $	extsf{NC}$ is contained in the class of languages recognized by fan-in-two circuit families whose size is bounded by $a(n+1)^k$ for some natural numbers $a$ and $k$.
